thread:
asha (CS): Hey team — Crestview's vendor risk form came back with a few hard flags around key management and on-prem data handling. They highlighted Q12 (KMS/HSM), Q14 (data residency / backups), and Q17 (access reviews). Need a tight draft by EOD to avoid blocking onboarding.

evan (security): I can take KMS/HSM (Q12). Quick question: do they want BYOK or just managed keys? We currently offer KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and HSM for Private. I'll draft both options.

sophie (product): For Dedicated we only surface managed KMS by default; Private supports customer-managed keys via KMS or HSM. For backups: we keep snapshot encryption at rest, stored in customer region for Private, and can provide residency attestation.

marco (legal): For Q17 access reviews — we can provide quarterly IAM review reports, and point to our SOC2 controls for access provisioning. I'll prepare the language, but need confirmation on retention windows for logs.

asha (CS): @evan + @marco great. Evan — include a short "how it works" snippet customers can paste. Marco — can you confirm log retention policy? Crestview specifically asked about 7-year retention for audit logs.

evan (security): Draft snippet: ```We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS/GCP KMS and HSM for Private deployments. Keys can be used in Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) mode; Redwood does not persist plaintext keys. Encryption is applied at rest and transit.``` Will add a FAQ blurb about rotation and compromise.

marco (legal): We can't promise 7 years by default for logs; our standard retention is 90 days for operational logs and 1 year for audit logs. For enterprise, we can negotiate extended retention under contract. I'll note that as an addendum.

doc-bot: Auto-link: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/kms-hsm — latest KMS/HSM integration guide (internal)

asha (CS): OK — plan: Evan + Marco to post combined answers here by 4pm PT. Sophie, can you approve product phrasing once it's in? Then I'll send to Crestview. If anyone can't meet, flag now.

sophie (product): Yep I'll review. :thumbsup:

evan (security): On it, will post by 3:30pm PT.

marco (legal): Will post language and contract note by 3:45pm PT.

asha (CS): Thanks team. Sending follow-up to customer after approvals. :raised_hands:
